spans.s:
चिहणकन्थ चिहण-कन्थ, अम्, n., N. of a
town.

चिहुर चिहुर, आस्, m. pl. = चिकुर, the hair
of the head.

चिह्न चिह्न, अम्, n. a mark, spot, stain,
stamp, sign, badge, symbol, symptom; a banner, a
standard, insignia; a sign of the zodiac; aim, direc-
tion towards; [cf. स-चिह्न.]
—चिह्न-कारिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, making or leaving marks, marking, spotting;
wounding, striking, killing; exciting fear, frightful,
hideous.
—चिह्न-धर, अस्, m. bearing the signs
or insignia (of office).
—चिह्न-धारिणी, f. the plant
Echites Frutescens, = श्यामा-लता.
—चिह्न-भूत,
अस्, आ, अम्, become a mark, formed into a mark.

चिह्नय, nom. P. चिह्नयति, -यितुम्, to mark,
sign, stamp, spot.

चिह्नित, अस्, आ, अम्, marked, signed, spotted,
stained, stamped, designated; known.
चिह्नी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, marked, delineated.
